strengths.text: Subsurface ice is close to the habitat.
Crater walls provide strong radiation protection.

weaknesses.text: Limited sunlight during the long winter.

opportunities.text: Ice extraction could support fuel production.

threats.text: A power failure during winter could become unrecoverable.

responses.critical-risk: Seasonal loss of solar generation creates a dangerous dependency on stored power.

risk-position.rationale: Strong science and water access with manageable risk if redundant nuclear power is added.

responses.crew-policy: Protect two hours of private, communication-free time for every crew member each day.
responses.required-change: Add a redundant nuclear microreactor and double winter power storage.
